summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. The diff is additive only (764 insertions, no removed lines). Not verified: I could not run tests, mypy, or black, so import behavior, type checks, and test results are unconfirmed. Next step is running pytest on tests/test_progress.py and mypy on rich. Choices made: mode 'tr' is treated as binary per the spec; method bodies call io.open because the module-level open shadows the builtin; Progress.open gets a catch-all str overload so the module-level function type-checks; only the spec's listed suppressions were added, which may need adjusting if mypy disagrees. No commits were made.
